<html class="no-js" lang="en"><head><style>
	/* rules for navigation menu */
	/* ========================================== */
	
	.my_links-group__link {
		color: #31313f;
		font-family: 'GothamBook';
		font-size: 12px;
		display: -webkit-box;

		display: block;

			-ms-flex-align: center;
				align-items: center;
		text-decoration: none;
		outline: none;
	}

	.my_links-group__link span {
		line-height: 1;
	}

	.my_links-group__link .icon {
		width: 20px;
		height: 18px;
	}

	.my_links-group__link .icon-shop-collection {
		width: 17px;
		height: 14px;
	}
	
	.my_links-group__link .icon-shop-category {

		height: 16px;
	}

	}
	.sub2 > li > a {
		background-color: #FCF9F7;
	}
	.sub3 > li > a {
		background-color: rgb(246, 243, 241);
	}

		position:absolute;
		top: 15px;
		right: 5px;
		width:0; 
		height:0; 
		border:5px solid; 
		border-color:#31313f transparent transparent transparent;
		background:transparent !important;
		transform: rotate(-90deg);
	}
	@media (max-width: 768px) {
	.my_links-group__link .icon {
			margin-right: 0px;
		}
	}

	.my_links-group__link:hover,
	.my_links-group__link:focus
	{
		text-decoration: none;
		color: #31313f;
		outline: none;
	}

		color: #31313f;
	}
	
	ul#navmenu {
		position: relative;
		margin: 0px auto;
		margin-bottom: 0px !important;
    padding-bottom: 0px !important;
		z-index: 100;
	}

	ul#navmenu, ul.sub1, ul.sub2,ul.sub3{
		list-style-type: none;
		font-size: 9pt;
	}
		
	ul#navmenu li {
		width: 140px;
		text-align: left;
		position: relative;
		float: left;
		margin-right: 20px;
		outline: none !important;
	}
		
	ul#navmenu a {
		text-decoration: none;
		font-display: GothamBook;
		color: #31313f;
		display: block;
		width: 160px;
		height: 40px;
		line-height: 40px;
		outline: none !important;
	}

	ul#navmenu .my_links-group__link {
		border: 0;
		border-radius:0;
	}
	ul#navmenu a{
		position: relative;
	}
	ul#navmenu .sub1 a {

		position: relative;
	}
		
	ul#navmenu .sub2 a {

	}
	ul#navmenu .sub3 a {
		margin-left: 3px;
		outline: none;
	}
		
	ul#navmenu li:hover > a,
	ul#navmenu li:focus > a
	{
		background-color: #eceef1;
		
	}
	ul#navmenu a::before {
		content: '';
		width: 100%;
		height: 3px;
		background-color: #1cb4d1;
		position: absolute;
		bottom: -1px;
		left: 0px;

<script>
	function setMouseenter(ele){
		ele.on('mouseenter',function(){
			ele.children('ul').addClass('show-menu')
		})
		ele.on('mouseleave',function(){
			ele.children('ul').removeClass('show-menu')
		})
		var childrenLi = ele.children('ul').children('li')
		if(childrenLi.length>0){
			for(var i =0;i<childrenLi.length;i++){
				setMouseenter($(childrenLi[i]));
			}
		}
	}
	function inactive(eleList){
		for ( var i = 0;i<eleList.length; i++){
				$(eleList[i]).children('a').removeClass('menu-item__active');
		}
	}
	function cancelStatus(){
		$('.show-menu').removeClass('show-menu');
		$('.menu-item__active').removeClass('.menu-item__active');
	}
	function setSubMenu(eleList){
		for ( var i = 0;i<eleList.length; i++){
				eleList[i].dataset.open = 0;
				$ele = $(eleList[i]);
				$ele.off('keyup').on('keyup',function(e){
					var $this = $(this);
					if(e.keyCode==9){
						inactive(eleList);
						$this.children('a').addClass('menu-item__active');
						if($this.children('ul').children('li').length>0){
							setSubMenu($this.children('ul').children('li'));
						}
					}
					if(e.keyCode==13){
						if($this.children('ul').length>0&&this.dataset.open==0){
							$this.children('ul').addClass('show-menu');
							$this.attr('data-open',1)
						}else if($this.children('ul').length>0&&this.dataset.open==1){
							$this.children('ul').removeClass('show-menu');
							$this.attr('data-open',0)
						}
					}
				})
		}
		$(eleList[eleList.length-1]).on('keydown',function(e){
			this.dataset.islast = 1;
			$this = $(this);
			if(e.keyCode==9){
				if($this.children('ul').length>0&&this.dataset.open==0){
					$this.children('a').removeClass('menu-item__active');		
					$this.parent().removeClass('show-menu');
				}else if($this.children('ul').length==0){
					$this.children('a').removeClass('menu-item__active');	
					$this.parent().removeClass('show-menu');
					if($this.parent().parent().parent().dataset){
						dataset.islast == 1 ?$this.parent().parent().parent().removeClass('show-menu'):null;
					}
				}
			}
		})
	}
		window.onload = function(){
			var $menu1 = $('#shopByCategoryMenu');
			var $menu2 = $('#shopByCollectionMenu');
			setMouseenter($menu1);
			setMouseenter($menu2);
			window.addEventListener('click',function(e){
				var ev = window.event || event;
				var ePath = ev.path||(ev.composedPath && ev.composedPath());
				var isInArea = ePath.some(function(ele){
					var id = ele.id
					return id =='icon-shop-category'|| id == 'icon-shop-collection'
				})
				if(!isInArea){
					cancelStatus();
				}
			})	
			
			$menu1.on('keyup',function(e){
				if(e.keyCode==9){
					var $firstLevel = $(this.children[1])
					$firstLevel.addClass('show-menu');
					var sub1MenuList = $('#icon-shop-category').children('li');
					setSubMenu(sub1MenuList);
				}
			})
			$menu2.on('keyup',function(e){
				if(e.keyCode==9){
					var $firstLevel = $(this.children[1]);
					$firstLevel.addClass('show-menu');
					var sub1MenuList = $('#icon-shop-collection').children('li');
					setSubMenu(sub1MenuList);
				}
			})
		}

<script>
        var clickShowPin = function(pinId){
            var pinHolderID = '#'+pinId;
            var isLiked =  $(pinHolderID+' .pinLikeIconClass').hasClass('fa-heart');
            var pinType = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__type').html();
            var pinTitle = $(pinHolderID+' .thumb__title').html();
            var pinImage = $(pinHolderID+' .pin_image_dummy').attr('src');
            var pinAuthorName = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__authorName').html();
            var pinAuthorLink = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__authorLink').html();
            var pinReviewText = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__reviewText').html();
            var pinReviewRate = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__reviewRate').html();
            var pinPurchaseUrl = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__purchaseUrl').html();
            var pinPurchaseProductImageUrl = $(pinHolderID+' .pin__hidden__info__purchaseProductImageUrl').html();
      
            $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogImage').attr('src',pinImage);
            $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogTitle').html(pinTitle);
            if (pinAuthorName && pinAuthorLink && pinAuthorName.length>0 && pinAuthorLink.length>0 && pinType != 'review'){
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogAuthor').html('@ ' + pinAuthorName);
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogAuthor').attr('href',pinAuthorLink);
            }else{
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogAuthor').html('');
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogAuthor').attr('href','');
            }
            if (pinType == 'review'){
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogReviewAuthor').html(pinAuthorName);
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogReviewText').html(pinReviewText);
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogProductImage').attr('src',pinPurchaseProductImageUrl);
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogProductShopButton').attr('href',pinPurchaseUrl);
      
                //show rate stars
                for (var i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
                  $(".star" + i)[0].href.baseVal = "/icons/icons.svg#" + (pinReviewRate >= i ? "icon-star-full" : "icon-star-empty");
                }
      
                //show right panel
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogBodyLeft').removeClass('col-md-12').addClass('col-md-6');
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogBodyRight').show();
            }else{
                //hide right panel
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogBodyLeft').removeClass('col-md-6').addClass('col-md-12');
                $('#pinDetailsModal .pinDialogBodyRight').hide();
            }
            $('#pinDetailsModal').modal({show:true});
        }
      
        $(document).ready(function () {
          var limit = 4;
        $('.ambassadorPostCarousel').slick({
            slidesToShow: 4,
            slidesToScroll: 1,
            autoplay: true,
            autoplaySpeed: 2000,
            arrows:false,
            responsive: [
              {
                breakpoint: 600,
                settings: {
                  slidesToShow: 3,
                  slidesToScroll: 1,
                  autoplay: true,
                  autoplaySpeed: 2000,
                  arrows:false
                }
              },
              {
                breakpoint: 480,
                settings: {
                  slidesToShow: 2,
                  slidesToScroll: 1,
                  autoplay: true,
                  autoplaySpeed: 2000,
                  arrows:false
                }
              }
            ]
          })
        });
      
      </script>

<script type="text/javascript">
	$(function(){
		$('.hero__slide').attr('tabindex',-1);
		$('.slick-arrow').attr('tabindex',-1);
	})

	$('.product_cell_add_cart').on('click',function(e) {
			e.preventDefault();
			e.originalEvent.cancelBubble = true;
			e.originalEvent.defaultPrevented = true;
			var productSku = e.currentTarget.dataset.type;
			$.ajax ({
				type: 'POST',
				url: '/postQuickAddtoCart',
				data: {sku: productSku},
				success: function(data, textStatus, jqXHR) {
					if (data.success) {
						window.open('/cart', '_self', false)
					} else {
						alert('Error! please contact our customer support!' + data.errorMsg)
					}
				}, 
				error: function(jqXHR, textStatus, errorThrown) {
					var errorMsg = jqXHR.responseText;
					console.error(errorMsg)
				},
				processData: true
			});
			return false;
	})
	$('.product_cell_like').on('click',function(e) {
		e.preventDefault();
		var userLogin = false;
		if (!userLogin){
			$('#loginModal').modal('show');
		}
		e.originalEvent.cancelBubble = true;
		e.originalEvent.defaultPrevented = true;
		var productSku = e.currentTarget.dataset.type;
		var productId = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
		var isCurrentLiked = false;
		$.ajax({
			type: 'POST',
			url: '/product/productCellPostLike',
			data: {
				'productId':productId,
				'is_like':!isCurrentLiked,
				'sku': productSku
			},
			success: function(data, textStatus, jqXHR) {
				if (data.success) {
					var productLikeId = productSku;
					var oldCount = $('#'+ productLikeId).html().split(' ')[1];
					var newCount = Number(oldCount)+1;
					if (newCount == 1) {
						$('#'+ productLikeId).html(newCount + ' like')
					} else {
						$('#'+ productLikeId).html(newCount + ' likes')
					}
				}
			},
			error: function(jqXHR,textStatus,errorThrown) {
				var errorMsg = jqXHR.responseText;
				console.log(errorMsg);

			},
			processData:true
		})
		return false;
	})
	
	/* when a user clicks, toggle the 'is-animating' class */
	$(".heart").on('click touchstart', function(){

	});

	/*when the animation is over, remove the class*/
	$(".heart").on('animationend', function(){
		$(this).toggleClass('is_animating');

	/*
		To implement carousel loading
		Input:parentNodeClassName:string itemClassName:string imgClassNameMobile:string imgClassNameDesk:string isMobile:boolean
		Output:none
	*/
	var carouselLazyload = function(parentNodeClassName,itemClassName,imgClassNameMobile,imgClassNameDesk){
		// caculate client with
		var isMobile = document.body.clientWidth>576?false:true;
		// handle class name for selector
		parentNodeClassName = '.'+parentNodeClassName;
		itemClassName = '.'+itemClassName;

		$(parentNodeClassName).slick({
			accessibility:true,
			dots: true,
			infinite: true,
			speed: 500,
			autoplay:true,
			fade: true,
			lazyLoad:'ondemand',
			cssEase: 'linear',
			prevArrow:"<a href='#!' class='slick-arrow slick-arrow--prev' role='none' tabindex='-1' name='previous product image button' aria-label='previous product image button' style='color:#1cb4d1;background-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'><svg role='img' class='icon icon-angle-left'><use xlink:href='/icons/icons.svg#icon-angle-left'></use></svg></a>",
			nextArrow:"<a href='#!' class='slick-arrow slick-arrow--next' role='none' tabindex='-1' name='next product image button' aria-label='next product image button' style='color:#1cb4d1;background-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.0)'><svg role='img' class='icon icon-angle-right'><use xlink:href='/icons/icons.svg#icon-angle-right'></use></svg></a>"
		}); 
		// init some flag values
		var carouselItemList =  document.querySelectorAll(itemClassName);
		var loadedCount = carouselItemList.length-1;
		carouselItemList[0] = null
		var tagArr = new Array(loadedCount)
		// bind beforeChange event
		$(parentNodeClassName).on('beforeChange',function(event, slick, currentSlide, nextSlide){
			// if this img has already loaded
			if(tagArr[nextSlide]==null){
				var targetContainer = $(carouselItemList[nextSlide]);
				// Build dom string
				var bannerItem = bannerList[nextSlide];
				var _imageUrl = isMobile?bannerItem.mobileImageUrl:bannerItem.imageUrl;
				var _altUrl = bannerItem.alt;
				var _className = isMobile?imgClassNameMobile:imgClassNameDesk;
				var htmlStr = '<img tabindex="-1" class="'+_className+'" src="'+_imageUrl+'" alt="'+_altUrl+'"/>'
			// Put dom string insert next node
				carouselItemList[nextSlide].innerHTML = htmlStr;
				tagArr[nextSlide] = 'done';
				loadedCount--;
				// unbind this event
				if(loadedCount==0){
					$(parentNodeClassName).off('beforeChange');
				}
			}
		})
	}

	carouselLazyload('carousel--hero','hero__slide','hero__mob','hero__desktop');
	</script>
<script>
  // caculate color's contrast ratio on white(#fff).
  function caculateLuminanceRatio(r,g,b){
			var RsRGB = r/255;
			var GsRGB = g/255;
			var BsRGB = b/255;
			var R = (RsRGB <= 0.03928) ? RsRGB/12.92 : Math.pow((RsRGB+0.055)/1.055, 2.4);
			var G = (GsRGB <= 0.03928) ? GsRGB/12.92 : Math.pow((GsRGB+0.055)/1.055, 2.4);
			var B = (BsRGB <= 0.03928) ? BsRGB/12.92 : Math.pow((BsRGB+0.055)/1.055, 2.4);
    	var curColorLuminance = 0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B;
			var whiteLuminance = 1;
			var luminanceRatio = (whiteLuminance+0.05)/(curColorLuminance+0.05)
			return luminanceRatio;
	}
	// caculateLuminanceRatio(20, 127, 148);
	var adjustIfLowContrast = function(colorStr){
		// the limite is according to the standard of WCAG2.0
		var highLimiteRatio= 4.5;
		var lowLimiteRatio= 1.5;
		var parts = colorStr.match(/^rgb\((\d+),\s*(\d+),\s*(\d+)\)$/).slice(1,4);
		parts = parts.map(function(item){
			return parseInt(item);
		})
		var curRatio = caculateLuminanceRatio(parts[0],parts[1],parts[2]);
		return (highLimiteRatio>curRatio)&&(lowLimiteRatio<curRatio);
	}
		
	$(function(){
		try{
			var contrastRate = localStorage.getItem('contrastRate');
			if(contrastRate=='high'){
				// Convert low mode to the high mode. 
				$("*").each(function(){
					var color = $(this).css('color');
					var bgColor = $(this).css('background-color');
					if(color&&color[3]!='a'){
						if(adjustIfLowContrast(color)){
							$(this).css({
								color:'#147F94'
							})
						}
					}
					if(bgColor&&bgColor[3]!='a'){
						if(adjustIfLowContrast(bgColor)){
							$(this).css({
								'background-color':'#147F94'
							})
						}
					}
				})
			}
		}catch(err){
			console.log('error with contrast adjustment',err);
		}
 	})
</script>
